insight.title: The End-of-History Illusion
insight.subtitle: Why we believe our personal evolution is finally complete.

sections.text: We easily recognize how much we have changed over the past decade, yet we consistently believe our current personality, values, and preferences will remain virtually identical for the rest of our lives.

Psychologists call this the "End-of-History Illusion." We view the present as a finished product rather than a transition point, largely because it is cognitively easier to remember the past than to imagine change.

This bias affects everything from long-term financial commitments to permanent aesthetic choices. We pay a premium today to satisfy a future self who may no longer share our current desires or identity.

ENDING:
We are always a work in progress claiming to be the final draft.
